interest: I want to know which cheap regularizers actually help a small bag-of-embeddings text classifier when labels are scarce, and why, rather than collecting another leaderboard point.
hunches: Word dropout helps mostly because it stops the model from leaning on a few topic-specific tokens, not because it acts like generic noise.
Part of any reported gain is early stopping in disguise: a regularized model simply peaks later within the same epoch budget.
avoid: Pure hyperparameter sweeps with no mechanism behind them
contribution: A mechanism claim with a matched control; a clean negative result is welcome.
known: A logistic-regression baseline reaches about 13.3% error on this split
